top_signals.title: Iran Moves to Restart Oil Exports Despite U.S. Naval Blockade
top_signals.summary: Iran is preparing to relaunch crude oil exports even as the United States says it is going to tighten the naval blockade on Iranian ports it imposed earlier this year in response to Iran’s closing of the Strait of Hormuz. Bloomberg reported earlier today that a cargo of Iranian crude had been transferred from a Suezmax tanker under U.S. sanctions to a medium-range vessel that is not under sanctions. The information comes from an anti-Iran organization named United Against Nuclear Iran and vessel tracker Kpler. A Reuters report cited TankerTrackers.com…

top_signals.title: Odd Lots: How an AI Native Company Chooses Its Models (Podcast)
top_signals.summary: This week, we got news that the Trump administration is reportedly considering a requirement for US companies to publicly disclose their use of Chinese AI models. Any effort to discourage US businesses from using Chinese open-source could be a big deal for both the AI industry and the market, where investors are still debating whether customers will ultimately be willing to pay for pricier homegrown frontier models versus cheaper alternatives.
